name: Music room
use: Jim's piano, played every day, and his records on a long console with a turntable.
also: Listening to music in the evening; a quiet room for a guest who plays.

name: Family room
use: Jim's evening living room: the long fire of lit mist, a sofa, books, the screen.
also: Films and calls home on the screen; chess by the glass.

name: Dining room and bar
use: Everyday meals, a table for eight; the bar at the back of the room.
also: Drinks after dinner; small dinners with guests.

name: Study
use: Jim's evening desk, on the upper storey over the family room: letters and video letters home, his accounts, the house's console.
also: A quiet room to read late.

name: Laundry and linen
use: Washing, ironing and the linen for the suite, next to the bath.
also: Robots' storeroom for the suite.

name: Bath
use: The master bath: a stone tub, a shower, two basins, a glass wall onto the moss garden.
also: A steam shower for the evenings.

name: Moss garden
use: A garden open to the lit roof, 8 m tall, between the bedroom and the bath: moss, a pond, stones, a maple.
also: Where Jim sits before sleep.

name: Bedroom
use: Jim's bedroom for the nights, under 16 m of soil: the bed faces a glass wall onto the moss garden.
also: Reading in bed; a sitting corner.

name: Dressing room
use: Clothes, shoes, the suits for going outside, behind the bedroom.

name: Kitchen
use: The everyday kitchen, across the street from the dining room. Robots cook; Jim can too.
also: Breakfast at the counter.

name: Pantry and cold store
use: Food from the garden level, kept for the kitchen.

name: Robot bay
use: Where the house robots that cook, clean and carry charge and are serviced.

name: Household stores
use: China, glass, furniture and decorations not in use.

name: Memory rooms
use: Jim's keepsakes from Earth: family photographs, letters and the things he brought from home, in a suite of quiet rooms.
also: Where he records his memoirs; where visiting family find the family's history.

name: Wardrobe and stores
use: Clothes and things not in daily use.

name: Residence plant room
use: The air, heat and water for the residence, with its own back-up.

name: Cinema
use: Forty seats in front of a screen 12 m wide: films.
also: Concerts and talks streamed from Earth; video calls with family on the big screen; a lecture hall when visitors come.

name: Games room
use: Billiards, cards and table tennis, which plays strangely in low gravity.
also: Evenings with guests.

name: Ballroom
use: Dances and celebrations when visitors arrive, every 26 months.
also: The rest of the time: dance, yoga and exercise classes, and exhibitions.

name: Wine cellar
use: The house's one cellar, cool and steady below ground, with a tasting table.
also: It supplies the Crown's wine room (C-16).

name: Club stores
use: Chairs, tables, instruments and decorations for the club.

name: Thermal baths
use: Long soaks: a warm pool at 36 °C, a round hot pool at 40 °C and a cold plunge at 14 °C, loungers along the glass.
also: Recovery after exercise; a quiet evening with guests.

name: Lap pool, 50 m
use: Training: lengths and water exercise, safe below ground.
also: Water sports in low gravity; swimming lessons for visiting children.

name: Sports hall
use: A climbing wall, ball games and a running track, all lively in low gravity.
also: The exercise that keeps bones and muscles strong (see Health in the science pages).

name: Sauna and steam
use: Saunas and steam rooms for the evening, next to the baths.

name: Treatment rooms
use: Massage and physiotherapy for bones and muscles in low gravity, with changing rooms for the baths.
also: Linked to the medical centre (L3-10).

name: Great library
use: The house's main collection, two storeys of books, read at long tables by the atrium glass.
also: Talks and readings when visitors come.

name: Archive of Earth
use: Earth's history and culture, and family records, to read and to look at.
also: Its sealed copy is in the vault (L5-11).

name: Film and music archive
use: Films and recordings, with booths to watch and listen.
also: Feeds the cinema (L1-17) and the music room (L1-01).

name: Book stacks
use: Robotic stacks that bring any book to the library or to any room.

name: Conservation workshop
use: Repairing, scanning and printing books; the library's stores.

name: Guest lounge
use: The guests' living and dining room on the atrium glass, two storeys tall.
also: Where guests and Jim meet in the evening.

name: Guest suite 1
use: A bedroom, a bath and a sitting room.

name: Guest suite 2
use: A bedroom, a bath and a sitting room.

name: Guest suite 3
use: A bedroom, a bath and a sitting room.

name: Guest suite 4
use: A bedroom, a bath and a sitting room.

name: Guest suite 5
use: A bedroom, a bath and a sitting room.

name: Guest suite 6
use: A bedroom, a bath and a sitting room.

name: Guest suite 7
use: A bedroom, a bath and a sitting room.

name: Guest suite 8
use: A bedroom, a bath and a sitting room.

name: Family apartment 1
use: For a family visiting with children: bedrooms, a kitchen, a living room.

name: Family apartment 2
use: For a family visiting with children: bedrooms, a kitchen, a living room.

name: Staff and robots
use: Rooms for staff, if any come; robot bays and stores for the guest wing.

name: Citrus grove
use: Oranges, lemons and limes under the sky of lamps.

name: Apples and pears
use: An orchard of apples and pears.

name: Olives and figs
use: Olives for oil, and figs.

name: Vineyard
use: Vines for grapes and wine.

name: Tree nursery
use: Young trees for the orchards and the city.

name: Market garden
use: Vegetables and herbs, picked fresh.

name: Vertical farm
use: Racks of greens under LEDs, the highest yields.

name: Grain and rice
use: Wheat, rice and beans.

name: Mushroom cellar
use: Mushrooms grown on the garden's waste.

name: Seed store
use: The farm's working seeds.

name: Lake
use: A lake that is also the house's water reserve.
also: Swimming and boating in summer light.

name: Fish farm
use: Fish for the table, fed from the gardens.

name: Pumps and filters
use: The lake's pumps and filters.

name: Forest walk
use: A forest with paths, under trees 12 m tall.

name: Stream and falls
use: A stream that falls into the lake.

name: Forest nursery
use: Young trees and plants for the forest.

name: Meadow and bees
use: A meadow of wild flowers, with hives.

name: Flower garden
use: Flowers for the house.

name: Tea house
use: A tea house in the meadow: tea, quiet, contemplation.
also: Small meetings away from the house. (The Crown's tea house of Rev B is folded into this one.)

name: Aquaponics
use: Fish and plants in one loop of water.

name: Compost and soil
use: Making soil from the house's waste.

name: Workshop
use: Jim's workshop for wood and metal.

name: Sculpture and casting hall
use: Big and heavy work: sculpture, casting, kilns.

name: Model hall
use: Room for big models: railways, rockets, the city.

name: Tool store
use: Tools and machines.

name: Materials
use: Timber, metals and materials.

name: Robot foundry
use: Prints the parts for the house and the city.

name: Regolith kilns
use: Fires Mars soil into panels and bricks.

name: Parts yard
use: Finished parts waiting for use.

name: Laboratories
use: Science: soil, ice, air, plants.

name: Medical centre
use: A doctor's surgery, a scanner and an operating room, with no evacuation possible.
also: Works with the treatment rooms (L1-26).

name: Clean rooms
use: Electronics and medicines made clean.

name: Test halls
use: Testing machines before use.

name: AI core
use: The house mind: the computers that run the house.

name: Data vault
use: The house's data, kept safe.

name: Earth link
use: The link to the relays and to Earth.

name: Cooling
use: Cooling for the computers.

name: Backup core
use: A second house mind, in case the first fails.

name: City control room
use: Runs the house, the city and the spaceport.

name: Storm watch
use: Weather and dust storms, radiation alerts.

name: Flight control
use: All flights and rovers: the pods, the ships, the rover trips.

name: Training
use: Training for robots and people: suits, rovers, emergencies.

name: Fission reactors
use: Two 5 MWe microreactors.

name: Fusion-ready bay
use: Kept for a fusion plant when one exists.

name: Ice melt
use: Melting the ice from the mine.

name: Purification
use: Removing the perchlorate salts.

name: Water recycling
use: 98% of the water used again.

name: Oxygen plant
use: Oxygen from carbon dioxide and water.

name: Nitrogen and argon
use: The buffer gases, from the Mars air.

name: Food for two years
use: The storm reserve.

name: Maglev hall
use: The station for the maglev to the spaceport (phase 2).

name: Seed vault
use: Seeds of Earth's plants, kept for centuries.

name: Earth memory vault
use: The sealed copy of the Archive of Earth.

name: Tunnel boring machines
use: They dig the city's tunnels.

name: City roots
use: The start of the tunnels to the city.

name: Suit room
use: Suits for going out by rover through the tunnel.
also: The second way out of the house.

name: Suit room
use: Suits and the airlock with a dust room, for going out onto the hull or the plain.

name: Pod hangar
use: The pods dock here, through a door in the outer wall.

name: The Door
use: The front door of the house, from the hangar.

name: Arrival hall
use: Where everyone arrives: 9 m tall, an olive bench, the portal to the Orb, the spires and the Pentagon.
also: Where visitors are welcomed.

name: Dock control
use: Upstairs in the Arrival spire: watches the pods dock.

name: Dressing room
use: Clothes for the day, next to the bedroom up.

name: Bedroom up
use: Jim's day room to rest in: a nap after lunch, reading; the bed faces the south-east slots, where the sun rises.
also: Changing between the morning and the afternoon.

name: Bath up
use: A bath with a soaking tub by the slots.
also: (The Rev B private spa is folded into the wellness rooms.)

name: Hearth room
use: A fireside corner of the salon, a hearth of lit mist.
also: Quiet talks.

name: Great salon
use: Jim's living room by day: linen sofas, olive trees, the sun through the slots, the view.
also: Receptions and parties when visitors come.

name: Recital room
use: The concert grand, played for guests: the salon's chairs turn to face it.
also: Rehearsing in daylight.

name: Sky lounge
use: Upstairs in the Salon spire: the highest view over the plain by day.
also: A quiet retreat.

name: Spa
use: A cedar sauna with a glass front and a round hot pool, with the view.

name: Sky pool, 25 m
use: Swimming in daylight along the ring, where low gravity makes every wave rise high and fall slowly.
also: Lying by the water in the sun.

name: Gym
use: Machines and weights with the view, for the daily exercise.

name: Wine room
use: Wine brought up from the cellar (L1-20) for the dinners, and served from here.

name: Dining hall
use: Dinners with guests: one basalt table for 22, the afternoon sun low through the slots.
also: Celebrations; meetings when visitors come.

name: Chef's kitchen
use: Cooks for the dining hall.

name: Sky bar
use: Upstairs in the Dining spire: drinks at sunset with the view west.

name: Guests' day room
use: Where visitors spend their days up here: desks, sofas, a kitchenette, a corner for children.
also: (Guests sleep below ground, in the guest wing on L1.)

name: Sunset lounge
use: Low sofas facing the west slots: at sunset the sun shines straight in, in a blue sky.
also: Evening drinks before going down.

name: Gallery
use: Jim's paintings from the studio and his photographs of Mars.
also: Exhibitions; a quiet room by the sunset lounge.

name: Study
use: Jim's day desk in the north light: writing, his memoirs, calls.

name: Library
use: Reading in daylight: two floors of walnut shelves with a working collection, a gallery and a spiral stair.

name: Map room
use: A globe of Mars 3 m across and chests of maps: planning trips and flights.

name: Reading gallery
use: Upstairs in the Library spire, a reading room under the roof.

name: Art studio
use: Painting and drawing in the steady north light.

name: Photo and print room
use: Printing Jim's photographs of Mars and his art.

name: Craft room
use: Pottery, models and small repairs (heavy work is in L3's workshops).

name: Star lounge
use: Night: reclining chairs under the slots and the real stars.
also: Parties at night.

name: Telescope room
use: The controls of the telescope upstairs, and screens for what it sees.
also: (The Rev B planetarium is gone: the Orb shows the universe.)

name: Telescope dome
use: Upstairs in the Observatory spire: the telescope.

name: Breakfast room
use: Breakfast with the sunrise through the east slots.
also: Morning coffee with guests.

name: Sky garden
use: Herbs, flowers and small trees under the slots: a conservatory in the ring.
also: Fresh herbs for the chef's kitchen.

name: Wormhole Gate
use: A ball 18 m across in the middle of the Orb: it sends Jim to any place and time.

name: Foyer
use: Under the Gate, round which the portals open.

name: Portal 1
use: The portal from the Arrival spire, in a room between the lanes, with seats to wait in.

name: Portal 2
use: The portal from the Salon spire, in a room between the lanes, with seats to wait in.

name: Portal 3
use: The portal from the Dining spire, in a room between the lanes, with seats to wait in.

name: Portal 4
use: The portal from the Library spire, in a room between the lanes, with seats to wait in.

name: Portal 5
use: The portal from the Observatory spire, in a room between the lanes, with seats to wait in.

name: Earth lounge
use: The universe zoomed to Earth: home, its weather, its news.
also: The universe fills the room at a switch.

name: Mars lounge
use: Mars, the house and the city.
also: The universe fills the room at a switch.

name: Solar system lounge
use: The planets and their moons.
also: The universe fills the room at a switch.

name: Galaxy lounge
use: The Milky Way: choosing far places for the Gate.
also: The universe fills the room at a switch.

name: Deep universe lounge
use: The web of galaxies and time.
also: The universe fills the room at a switch.

name: Bridge into the Gate
use: 3 m wide, from the inner lane into the Gate.

name: Jim's rest room
use: A day bed, a window to the sky behind radiation glass, a glass wall onto the Gate that turns frosted.

use: A day bed, a window to the sky behind radiation glass, a glass wall onto the Gate that turns frosted.
